name: Arcanea — Observe recent Art Blocks projects

parameters.query:
WITH capture AS (
  SELECT $1::text AS body, $2::text AS slot, $3::timestamptz AS observed,
         $4::text AS sha, $5::text AS run_ref
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO public.campaign_signals
    (platform, source_id, signal_type, status, content, metadata, detected_at, engagement_score)
  SELECT 'artblocks', 'eth-recent-v1/' || slot, 'market_trend', 'processed',
    'Recently activated Ethereum projects. Invocations measure mints; sales and buyer counts are unknown.',
    jsonb_build_object('schema','arcanea.collector.sample.v1','category','generative_art',
      'source_url','https://data.artblocks.io/v1/graphql','selection','20 most recently activated active Ethereum projects',
      'observed_at',observed,'slot_utc',slot,'source_sha256',sha,'run_ref',run_ref,
      'archive','r2://starlight-mission-artifacts/arcanea/collector/v1/' || sha || '.json',
      'projects', body::jsonb #> '{data,projects_metadata}'), observed, NULL
  FROM capture WHERE sha = encode(sha256(convert_to(body,'UTF8')),'hex')
  ON CONFLICT (platform, source_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT sha FROM capture) <> encode(sha256(convert_to($1,'UTF8')),'hex')
    THEN 'hash_mismatch' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT FROM inserted) THEN 'inserted'
    ELSE 'slot_already_recorded' END AS outcome, (SELECT id FROM inserted) AS new_id;

SELECT (SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'sha', metadata->>'source_sha256', 'run_ref', metadata->>'run_ref') FROM public.campaign_signals WHERE platform = 'artblocks' AND source_id = 'eth-recent-v1/' || $1::text) AS accepted;
